headline: Joseph Yobo backs Alex Iwobi to break Ahmed Musa's Nigeria appearance record
description: Former Nigeria captain Joseph Yobo believes Alex Iwobi can push his international career beyond 130 appearances, after becoming only the fourth Super Eagles player to reach 100 caps.

headline: Emmanuel Adebayor tips Antoine Semenyo to be the 'best and key' player for Manchester City
description: Former Arsenal and Manchester City forward Emmanuel Adebayor told Antoine Semenyo to trust his ability and play without pressure, predicting the Ghana forward can establish himself as one of City's most important players.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Bayern sign Haaland to replace Kane?
description: Erling Haaland is contracted to Manchester City for another eight years, but could Bayern Munich sign him? Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United want Guirassy as potential Zirkzee replacement
description: Manchester United are keeping tabs on Borussia Dortmund's Serhou Guirassy. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Andy Robertson opens up about Liverpool after Diogo Jota's death: 'We didn't care about football'
description: Former Liverpool defender Andy Robertson has said that the death of teammate Diogo Jota was "horrendous" and had a major impact on the players that knew him.

headline: Estêvão on reduced game time at Chelsea: 'I try to seize every opportunity I have'
description: Estêvão says he is focused only on what he can control after struggling for game time at Chelsea under new manager Xabi Alonso.
